correctness.rationale: On a great circle, a harmonic cubic is A cos(3t)+B sin(3t)+C cos(t)+D sin(t), and <Q_q(u)v,v>=p''(0)+p(0)=-8A. The third-frequency amplitude is an exact six-point alternating average and is at most ||q||_infinity, giving the sharp universal factor 8; Re(u1+i u2)^3 attains it. For q_plus, |q_plus|<=a^2 b=(1-b^2)b<=2/(3sqrt(3)), and the displayed orthonormal great circle is exactly a pure third harmonic of that amplitude, so M_plus=16/(3sqrt(3)). Oddness gives both spectral signs, yielding the exact semidefinite and positive-definite epsilon thresholds. Endpoint invariant arithmetic matches the source normalization.
